description: This file defines the 'Connection' interface within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity package, including its methods, JSON serialization details, and related constants for JSON fields. It models a network connection with properties like ID, name, type, status, sources, targets, credentials, URI components, and configuration options.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: An interface representing a network connection within the Connectivity service, with methods to access connection properties, configuration, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: JsonFields
classes.description: A final class containing static definitions of JSON field metadata for the Connection object, including fields like id, name, connectionType, connectionStatus, credentials, uri, sources, targets, clientCount, failoverEnabled, validateCertificates, processorPoolSize, specificConfig, mappingDefinitions, tags, and trustedCertificates.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of this Connection.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the optional name of this Connection.

methods.name: getConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the type of this Connection.

methods.name: getConnectionStatus
methods.description: Returns the persisted or desired status of this Connection.

methods.name: getSources
methods.description: Returns a list of sources for this Connection.

methods.name: getTargets
methods.description: Returns a list of targets for this Connection.

methods.name: getClientCount
methods.description: Returns the number of clients that should establish this Connection, indicating HA mode if greater than 1.

methods.name: isFailoverEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether failover is enabled for this Connection.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Returns optional persisted credentials for this Connection.

methods.name: getTrustedCertificates
methods.description: Returns optional trusted certificates in PEM format.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI of this Connection.

methods.name: getProtocol
methods.description: Returns the protocol part of the URI.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username part of the URI.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password part of the URI.

methods.name: getHostname
methods.description: Returns the hostname part of the URI.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number of the URI.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the path part of the URI.

methods.name: isValidateCertificates
methods.description: Indicates whether server certificates should be validated.

methods.name: getProcessorPoolSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the command processor pool.

methods.name: getSpecificConfig
methods.description: Returns a map of configuration specific to the ConnectionType.

methods.name: getPayloadMappingDefinition
methods.description: Returns the payload mapping definitions for this Connection.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns the set of tags associated with this Connection.

methods.name: getLifecycle
methods.description: Returns the current lifecycle state of this Connection.

methods.name: hasLifecycle
methods.description: Checks if this Connection has the specified lifecycle.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder initialized with this Connection's properties for modification.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns a JSON object representing this Connection with non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Returns a JSON object for this Connection based on schema version and field selector.
